verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The two inequalities are stated verbatim: TargetCone.inward is 𝒯·N < 0 and TargetCone.ratio_lt_one with targetRatio is |c₀(𝒯·K)/(𝒯·N)| < 1, with the same c₀ and the same N. The sign convention for K noted under eq-p074-1 does not reach this display, because K enters only inside the absolute value. The third clause, 𝒯_{0,*} = (Q/q)^{A+1/2}𝒯₀, is not formed anywhere I found: PrimaryGeometryAssembly.Prepared instead carries a unit target field (target_unit: ‖target p‖ = 1, target_actual: target p = normalDirection (stressVector …) on the open active interval, which is the paper's 'smooth unit stress direction' reading at the edges). The rewriting is one line: (Q/q)^{A+1/2} > 0, and both conditions are invariant under multiplication of 𝒯 by a positive scalar (targetRatio_smul, TargetCone.pos_smul), so the condition on the unit direction and the condition on 𝒯_{0,*} are the same condition. Prepared.target_margin is the same pair with a uniform slack eta and the right-hand side slopeRatio u = u/√(1+u²), which is the page's next sentence (choose u_* with u_*/√(1+u_*²) above the supremum of the quotient) rather than (7.1) itself.
